prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.7 °C (70% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.9 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.3 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.81 s (within 1% of healthy). A small switching delay appears during the main pressure transient, reflecting early valve degradation.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.34 l/min (4% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 374 W·min/l (2% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 57.7 % (within 2% of healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.4 bar (3% below healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
